cohort: 948,020 singleton births in English National Health Service hospitals
finding: The study found very small decreases in preterm birth and SGA birth rates and very small increases in induction of labor and elective and emergency cesarean section during the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: Compared to the pre-pandemic period, the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with slightly higher rates of obstetric intervention, including induction of labor, elective cesarean section, and emergency cesarean section.
